_doc: Broadcast-style camera behind the offense (render/view.ts), in yards. The axis always points straight downfield: it never rotates with the QB or his gaze; scrambles only move it along the field. follow* are smoothing rates per second. fov: vertical field of view of the broadcast view (narrower than QB eyes). defense: behind the user's cornerback (back = yards behind him), looking lookAhead yards past him toward the offense, leaning lookToBall of the way toward the ball; he stays centered. defenseUnits (Phase 3b): overrides of `defense` for the selected defender's unit (linemen sit higher to see over the line).
_docFormation: Phase 4 default defense camera (render/view.ts updateFormationCamera): Madden-style view from behind the defense, high enough to show the whole formation, the line, the safeties and the receivers. The camera sits at max(ball + behindBall, deepest defender + behindDeepest) yd on the defense's side, height yd up, looking lookAhead yd past the ball toward the offense. Laterally it follows lateralShare of the ball's offset from the middle of the field plus userShare of the user's defender's offset from the ball. It never rotates with the play. The old player-level camera (`defense`, `defenseUnits`) stays as the PLAYER setting.
